title: Framing a zoom shows one box, and the pointer says what it will grab
goal: While a zoom region is picked, the picture shows the zoom box and the clip's own selection handles at once, so there are two boxes and nothing says which one a press will move. Framing a zoom should show only the zoom box, with the pointer changing over its corners and body, and Escape should let the zoom go.
notes: Left rough by a-zoom-region-that-frames-a-spot-and-can-follow (audit 2026-09-30-zoom-regions). Box presses are handled in CanvasNSView via zoomBoxUp/onZoomBoxDown (CanvasPointerDrags.swift) and drawn by ZoomBoxOverlay (hit testing off), so the cursor cue belongs in CanvasPointerCue.toolCursor and the handles in the canvas selection chrome when editorState.showsZoomBox. Seen in /tmp/photonz-playtest/a-zoom-follows-the-cursor-walk/1-zoom-added-box-on-the-picture-sc.png.
acceptance: With a zoom picked and the transport stopped, the clip's own selection handles are not drawn; only the zoom box is
The pointer shows a resize cursor over the box's corners and a hand over its body
Escape lets a picked zoom go
A walk at Next defaults photographs the framing state with one box
